follow-up time: Until termination of pregnancy or 6 months after surgery
cohort: 129 fetuses diagnosed with isolated Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) between January 2019 and December 2021 in China.
finding: Termination of pregnancy was common (42.6%) among fetuses with TOF in China, with larger maternal age being a protective factor, while live births with TOF were managed safely and effectively with a high rate of surgical repair.
